name: Darkshire
summary: In Darkshire, the Night Watch holds the line as the town endures Duskwood's unnatural gloom. Stormwind offers little aid, leaving the people to guard their homes.

sections.title: A Town Abandoned
sections.body: Darkshire was once the peaceful woodland settlement of Grand Hamlet. The Old Horde razed it during the First War, and the village was rebuilt. After Medivh fell at Karazhan, the death throes left in the surrounding woods turned them into the shadowed wilderness of Duskwood. Though Darkshire belongs to the Kingdom of Stormwind, the crown sends virtually no aid to its town hall. Political paralysis in Stormwind City has left the garrison unstaffed and the borders unpatrolled. Mayor Ello Ebonlocke and the local council are left to govern on their own, enforcing harsh, insular justice in the shadows.

sections.title: The Line in the Dark
sections.body: Walking dead from the western graveyards and feral worgen in the woods press against Darkshire's palisades. The Night Watch, a voluntary civilian militia led by Althea Ebonlocke, is the town's chief defense. From the town square, its weary sentries patrol the pitch-black roads, keep them open, and turn back terrors at the tree line. Travelers at the Scarlet Raven Tavern meet locals who are suspicious, frightened, and desperate for anyone able to wield a blade.

faq.q: Why was the town renamed from Grand Hamlet?
faq.answer: The settlement was called Grand Hamlet when the region was a sunny forest. After Medivh died at nearby Karazhan, dark magic spread through the woods, blocking sunlight and raising the dead. As the forest decayed into Duskwood, residents renamed the village Darkshire to reflect their bleak, cursed surroundings.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind helping defend Darkshire?
faq.answer: Stormwind withdrew its troops from Duskwood amid political turmoil after King Varian Wrynn disappeared. The townspeople formed the Night Watch to face threats the crown no longer contained.

aliases: who is in charge of darkshire
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke and the Council of Darkshire hold civic authority from the town hall, alongside town clerk Daltry. Ello's daughter, Commander Althea Ebonlocke, leads the Night Watch in the town's defense.

The Night Watch is a civilian militia formed by Althea Ebonlocke out of necessity. With no Stormwind Army troops sent to Duskwood, townsfolk patrol the gloomy roads, guard the borders, and drive back ghouls and rogue beasts.

Morgan Ladimore was a veteran who returned after the Third War to find his home ruined and his family missing. His search brought him to Darkshire, where local accounts preserve the rest of his story.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Darkshire shows how the kingdom's frontier is fracturing. The townsfolk are grateful to its heroes, yet bitter toward the unresponsive nobility in Stormwind City.
As a paladin, you find the dead rising in every surrounding cemetery and frightened locals who have nearly forgotten the Light. Unholy blights are plentiful around the village perimeter.
